channel.description: The Aspire channel to use for package resolution (e.g., "stable", "preview", "staging"). Used by aspire add to determine which NuGet feed to use.

features.description: Feature flags for enabling/disabling experimental or optional features. Key is feature name, value is enabled (true) or disabled (false).

defaultWatchEnabled.description: Enable or disable watch mode by default when running Aspire applications for automatic restarts on file changes

experimentalHostingIntegrations.description: Enable experimental hosting integrations authored outside .NET

experimentalPolyglotGo.description: Enable or disable experimental Go language support for polyglot Aspire applications

experimentalPolyglotJava.description: Enable or disable experimental Java language support for polyglot Aspire applications

experimentalPolyglotPython.description: Enable or disable experimental Python language support for polyglot Aspire applications

experimentalPolyglotRust.description: Enable or disable experimental Rust language support for polyglot Aspire applications

nugetSignatureVerificationEnabled.description: Enable or disable defaulting the DOTNET_NUGET_SIGNATURE_VERIFICATION environment variable for NuGet operations

polyglotIntegrationFilterEnabled.description: (Experimental) Restrict 'aspire add', 'aspire integration list', and 'aspire integration search' in non-C# AppHosts to integrations carrying the 'polyglot' NuGet tag. Disabled by default because no remote feed resolves the tag usefully today: Azure DevOps Artifacts feeds ignore 'tags:' query scoping, and nuget.org returns no first-party integrations for it. The filter fails closed, so enabling it against a remote feed hides every integration. Enable it only against a local package source or hive, where the tag is read from the nuspec.

showAllTemplates.description: Show all available templates including experimental ones in 'aspire new' and 'aspire init' commands

showDeprecatedPackages.description: Show or hide deprecated packages in 'aspire add' search results

stagingChannelEnabled.description: Enable or disable access to the staging channel for early access to preview features and packages

updateNotificationsEnabled.description: Check if update notifications are disabled and set version check environment variable

integrationSources.description: Named NuGet integration sources and allowed package patterns, merged across configuration layers.

enabled.description: Whether to search this source. Defaults to true. Disable default to omit built-in channel and NuGet discovery.

source.description: NuGet service index URL or local package directory. The default entry uses built-in discovery when omitted.

patterns.description: Optional allowed package IDs: exact IDs, prefixes ending in *, or * for all packages. Defaults to * when omitted.

language.description: The language identifier for this AppHost (e.g., "typescript", "python"). Used to determine which runtime to use for execution.

packages.description: Package references as an object literal (like npm's package.json). Key is package name, value is version.

sdkVersion.description: The Aspire SDK version used for this polyglot AppHost project. Determines the version of Aspire.Hosting packages to use.

skillSources.description: Named agent skill sources, merged across configuration layers. The built-in default source remains enabled unless explicitly disabled.

enabled.description: Whether to register this source. Defaults to true. Set default.enabled to false to omit the built-in Aspire source.

repository.description: GitHub owner/repository or an HTTPS/SSH Git repository URL containing the agent marketplace.

marketplace.description: Agent marketplace identifier. Defaults to the source name, or aspire-skills for the default source.

plugins.description: Plugin names within the marketplace. Defaults to ["aspire"].

ref.description: Optional marketplace Git ref. Existing agent-side pins are preserved.

openCodeV1Catalog.description: HTTPS skills catalog URL for OpenCode V1. Omit for sources without an OpenCode catalog.

openCodeV2Catalog.description: HTTPS skills catalog URL for OpenCode V2. Omit for sources without an OpenCode catalog.
